title: One workflow, from input to deliverable
best_for: One role learning a focused app workflow
A reviewed deliverable and reusable personal skill

chapter_outline.title: Start from the source
chapter_outline.purpose: Take one role from raw fictional inputs to a first result in a running document.

chapter_outline.title: Refine the deliverable
chapter_outline.purpose: Improve the first result using the same evidence and declared headings.

chapter_outline.title: Challenge the result
chapter_outline.purpose: Find and repair a planted unsupported claim without a supplied prompt.

chapter_outline.title: Make it repeatable
chapter_outline.purpose: Turn reviewed prompts into a personal skill, approve its draft, then test on fresh fictional inputs.

quality_bar: Use one fictional role, one workflow and one running deliverable; later steps use earlier outputs.
Declare running-document headings; copy quote and clause key facts verbatim with source files and sections.
Check numerical results with code and separate interpretation from source text.
Provide a prompt-free challenge, checked expected facts, chapter-start checkpoints and a manual-paste fallback.
Fix every validation warning; package learner files separately from facilitator answers.
Use different test-input numbers with their own expected facts; reuse a saved prompt if personal skills are unavailable.
ends_with: A finished deliverable and a reviewed personal skill tested on new fictional data, or the saved-prompt fallback.

title: From one prompt to a reusable workflow
best_for: Learners ready to move beyond single prompts
A presenter-led path from evidence to reusable skills
required_inputs: One fictional task carried across every rung
Personal and shared skill or agent permissions

chapter_outline.title: One prompt, one result
chapter_outline.purpose: Create a first result that later rungs will improve, not replace.

chapter_outline.title: Ground the prompt in files
chapter_outline.purpose: Rework the first result using fictional sources and traceable evidence.

chapter_outline.title: Connect a multi-step task
chapter_outline.purpose: Use the grounded result in a planned Cowork task with explicit review points.

chapter_outline.title: Make a personal skill
chapter_outline.purpose: Capture the reviewed multi-step approach and test it on fresh fictional inputs.

chapter_outline.title: Explore shared reuse
chapter_outline.purpose: Optionally watch a presenter adapt the personal skill to a shared skill or agent; otherwise review a sharing plan in the same slot.

quality_bar: Each rung uses the prior rung's output and the same fictional story.
A grounded prompt names its source and checked expected facts, not an invented reference.
Use chapter-start checkpoints from chapter three onward and separate learner files from facilitator keys.
Use a prompt-free challenge and review permissions before any Cowork saving or sharing.
Personal skills require learner review; saved prompts are the fallback when unavailable.
The shared skill or agent rung is optional and presenter-led, not a promise of tenant capabilities.
Fix all validation warnings and check quotes, sections, dates and calculations.
ends_with: A tested personal skill, plus an optional presenter-led shared skill or agent demonstration or a reviewed sharing plan.

title: One department, one fictional day
best_for: A department learning together across roles
A connected day with separately buildable hands-on labs

chapter_outline.title: Foundations lab
chapter_outline.purpose: Establish a common fictional story and source-grounded workflow.

chapter_outline.title: Morning break
chapter_outline.purpose: Pause and reset the practice workspace.

chapter_outline.title: Role one: prepare the evidence
chapter_outline.purpose: Build the first role's reviewed evidence handoff.

chapter_outline.title: Role two: compare decisions
chapter_outline.purpose: Use the evidence handoff to compare decisions from another role.

chapter_outline.title: Lunch break
chapter_outline.purpose: Pause before the afternoon role lab.

chapter_outline.title: Role three: plan the handoff
chapter_outline.purpose: Turn the reviewed decision into a checked delivery plan.

chapter_outline.title: Afternoon break
chapter_outline.purpose: Reset before the independent closing challenge.

chapter_outline.title: Prompt-challenge close
chapter_outline.purpose: Build separately as html_lab for now; move to prompt_a_thon when that format ships.

chapter_outline.title: Find the evidence
chapter_outline.purpose: Start the shared fictional story and inspect its sources.

chapter_outline.title: Check and refine
chapter_outline.purpose: Build a reviewed common baseline for the role labs.

chapter_outline.title: Keep the workflow
chapter_outline.purpose: Make a reusable starting skill and verify it on fresh inputs.

chapter_outline.title: Create the role's first result
chapter_outline.purpose: Use the morning baseline to create an evidence brief.

chapter_outline.title: Challenge the evidence
chapter_outline.purpose: Correct a planted gap and prepare a traceable handoff.

chapter_outline.title: Reuse the evidence workflow
chapter_outline.purpose: Save a reviewed personal skill and test a different input set.

chapter_outline.title: Read the evidence handoff
chapter_outline.purpose: Use role one's checked output to frame a decision note.

chapter_outline.title: Compare and challenge
chapter_outline.purpose: Separate supported options from unsupported interpretation.

chapter_outline.title: Reuse the decision workflow
chapter_outline.purpose: Capture the reviewed prompts and test a new fictional case.

chapter_outline.title: Plan from the reviewed decision
chapter_outline.purpose: Use role two's decision note in a practical delivery plan.

chapter_outline.title: Test the handoff
chapter_outline.purpose: Find a planted handoff risk and escalate uncertain interpretations.

chapter_outline.title: Reuse the planning workflow
chapter_outline.purpose: Review a personal skill and test a changed deadline or quantity.

chapter_outline.title: Frame the independent challenge
chapter_outline.purpose: Choose a fresh fictional case using the department's common evidence rules.

chapter_outline.title: Solve and compare
chapter_outline.purpose: Attempt a prompt-free challenge and compare against a facilitator answer.

chapter_outline.title: Keep and test the best approach
chapter_outline.purpose: Refine the existing personal skill and test it on new inputs.

quality_bar: Use one department and one invented company across every lab; never use customer data.
The day agenda includes breaks and totals 300 minutes; each lab slot matches its named outline's duration.
Build and validate each lab separately as html_lab, not the whole day as one LabSpec.
The prompt-challenge close stays html_lab until prompt_a_thon is available.
Pass reviewed outputs between role labs and provide starting checkpoints so each can also run independently.
Give each lab its own learner and facilitator folders, expected facts, headings and manual fallback.
Fix all validation warnings; check verbatim quotes, sections, dates and calculations with appropriate tools.
For sensitive domains include an advice disclaimer, fictional parties and questions for an expert.
ends_with: Five independently shareable HTML lab packs, a connected departmental handoff and a prompt-challenge close using fresh fictional data.
